program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((items (sort (map (lambda (obj)
                             (list (obj-size obj)
                                   (obj-r1 obj)
                                   (obj-c1 obj)
                                   (subgrid g (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))))
                           (objects g 0))
                      (lambda (a b)
                        (cond [(not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b))]
                              [(not (= (second a) (second b))) (< (second a) (second b))]
                              [else (< (third a) (third b))]))))
         (rects (map fourth items))
         (out-h (apply max (map rows rects)))
         (out-w (+ (apply + (map cols rects)) (max 0 (- (length rects) 1)))))
    (let pack ([remaining rects] [left 0] [out (empty-grid out-h out-w 0)])
      (if (empty? remaining)
          out
          (let* ((rect (first remaining))
                 (next (for*/fold ([acc out])
                                   ([r (in-range (rows rect))]
                                    [c (in-range (cols rect))])
                         (let ((v (at rect r c)))
                           (if (not (= v 0)) (set-cell acc r (+ left c) v) acc)))))
            (pack (rest remaining) (+ left (cols rect) 1) next))))))
